days.note: Header read off the graphic: SET TIMES · MIAMI BAYFRONT PARK · MARCH 2022 FRI 25 · FRIDAY · FROM 4:00 PM TO 12:00 AM. Seven stage columns: ULTRA MAIN STAGE, LIVE STAGE, MEGASTRUCTURE and WORLDWIDE STAGE on the left panel, THE COVE, UMF RADIO and OASIS on the right; stage names are the column logos, uppercased (RESISTANCE prints over MEGASTRUCTURE and THE COVE). Every block prints a start only ("• 9:40 PM"), so every row is open-ended. A smaller coloured word beside or under a name (LIVE, ANALOG, HYBRID LIVE, THE LIVE EXPERIENCE, a presents line) is kept in parentheses after it, as printed; a coloured B2B, B3B or X joins the names. This is the site's own 1600x1000 copy, which is legible. THE COVE prints the FCKNG SERIOUS logo beside it and UMF RADIO the STMPD RCRDS logo this day; the stages are THE COVE and UMF RADIO.
